harness/epic*): curses-era screens (console_plan, setup_tui, home_model's panes, runs_top's
highlight, editor_model's effect runner and fragments.py), wrappers with a live twin (claim_row,
work_state_mode_at, resolve_lake_at, count_completions, unmet_after, close_to_done,
clean_gate_finding, extract_json, discover_migrations), and writers nothing calls any more
(record_usage, system_one_report, land_failure, handoff serialise/parse).

order and refusal tests run through migrate and pending, the claim tests through claim_outcome,
render_lines keeps its own test, and the shadow-tag test checks the backend on the ledger row
instead of usage.json.

fragments.py had no importer at all; the scan missed it because core/cartridge.py has a local
named `fragments`.
